dex.text: A tall figure in a wide hat, with a scythe and a cart whose axle creaks. If you hear the creak at night, it is polite not to look round.
dex.fact: In Breton folklore the Ankou is death's servant. The last person to die in a parish in the year becomes the Ankou for the next, and he drives a creaking cart to collect the dead. He is carved on many Breton churches and ossuaries.
